name: class var vs instance var
code:
class Tally:
    total = 0
    def bump(self):
        Tally.total += 1
        return Tally.total
p = Tally()
q = Tally()
print(p.bump(), q.bump(), Tally.total, p.total)

name: class shared mutable
code:
class Reg:
    seen = []
    def mark(self, v):
        self.seen.append(v)
a = Reg()
b = Reg()
a.mark(1)
b.mark(2)
print(Reg.seen, a.seen, b.seen)
